provider_name: National Bureau of Statistics of China
publication_name: National data, National Bureau of Statistics website
access_description: The English terms of service were read. They allow download and use of statistical data and limit reprinting. They do not publish an unauthenticated machine-readable API licence. No endpoint was called.
auth_requirement: No official unauthenticated API licence was found. A 2020 NBS reply said users register to download from the data library. No account was created.
conditions: Technically blocked for unattended collection and rights pending for commercial publication. Do not scrape. Do not call an undocumented data endpoint. Do not import a FRED mirror. A file import is not allowed until a fragment cites a licence that permits retention and commercial publication. Do not store a cumulative year-to-date growth rate as an ordinary monthly observation.
revision_behaviour: Not collected. No monthly CPI, industrial production, or other NBS observation was stored.
unresolved_questions: The March 2026 data-library announcement does not state an API licence. Section III allows download and use. Section II limits reprinting to reasonable quotation for news or free public information and says the user must not allow others to keep reprinting without authorisation. That is not a grant of commercial publication.
evidence_note: Technically blocked and rights pending. The terms of service dated 2022-09-06 were read on 2026-10-24. They say statistical data may be downloaded and used, and that reprinting must indicate the National Bureau of Statistics. They also say reprinting must be reasonable quotation for news or free public information, must not distort the content, and must not allow others to continue reprinting without authorisation. The security section prohibits scanning or testing the system. The 27 March 2026 announcement launches a trial of the new data library at https://data.stats.gov.cn/ and does not grant automated collection. No series key was assigned. Cumulative year-to-date growth was not stored as a monthly observation. No FRED series was imported. Assessed 2026-10-24.
